chars.DAD: DAD: a Moroccan man in his sixties with a short grey beard, wearing a cream djellaba and a white knitted taqiya cap
chars.SON: SON: a Moroccan man in his late twenties with short curly black hair and light stubble, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie and dark jeans
chars.HAJJ: HAJJ: a plump Moroccan man in his sixties with a full white beard, wearing a brown wool djellaba and a red fez

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: In a simple rural Moroccan village house living room with low cushioned seats and a mint tea tray, DAD sits facing SON and points a firm finger at him with a serious, decisive face, while SON leans back on the cushion grinning in disbelief. Both in the centre of the frame, warm afternoon light.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Same rural Moroccan living room: SON laughs out loud holding his belly, teasing, while DAD frowns and wags his finger at him disapprovingly. Playful comic mood, both in the centre.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Same living room: DAD smiles dreamily with his hand on his heart and eyes half closed as if remembering sweet times, holding a glass of mint tea, while SON watches him with a skeptical raised eyebrow. Soft golden light, cosy and funny.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Same living room: SON shrugs with both palms up and an awkward embarrassed smile, while DAD looks at him thoughtfully stroking his grey beard. Both in the centre.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Same living room: SON waves his hand casually as if saying 'you decide', relaxed on the cushion, while DAD leans forward with a sly knowing smile like he already has a plan. Both in the centre.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Same living room: DAD stands up proudly and points toward the door announcing something, while SON sits frozen with wide shocked eyes and his mouth open, tea glass stopped halfway to his lips. Comic surprise, both in the centre.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: In front of a mirror in the village house bedroom, SON now wears an ill-fitting cheap black suit with too-long sleeves and a crooked red tie, looking at himself uncomfortably, while DAD in a grey suit jacket over his djellaba straightens SON's tie with a proud smile. Funny, warm light, both in the centre.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Inside a bright traditional Moroccan salon with patterned zellige walls and long sofas, DAD and SON in their cheap black suits sit stiffly side by side, staring with nervous curiosity toward a doorway, while HAJJ stands beside the doorway smiling and gesturing invitingly toward it. The doorway shows only a soft blurred silhouette of a young woman in a light headscarf, her face not visible. Suspenseful and funny, characters in the centre.
